curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Walk through the warning signs that send brakes, steering and shocks to a mechanic, the outside light check, clear glass and wipers, the horn's warning role, tire pressure checks and the penny test.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per check; a contrast card for the penny test pass versus fail.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on vehicle warning signs, lights, glass and tires.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover the owner manual maintenance schedule, engine trouble signs, exhaust dangers, the sixty day emissions retest window, fuel and carbon dioxide, aftermarket equipment limits, and the insurance lapse steps.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; a contrast card for the insurance warning versus registration suspension.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on maintenance, emissions and insurance.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach seat and mirror setup, stowing cargo, the belt and child restraint rule, what airbags do not cover, lap and shoulder straps, and the separate citations for each unbelted occupant.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for airbags versus belts and for separate belt citations.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on mirrors, belts, airbags and belt citations.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Lay out the child seat tiers by age and weight, the stricter seat rule for split cases, and the rear facing seat and front airbag rule.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per tier rule; contrast cards for the younger and older tiers.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz that swaps the age and weight tiers.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover the belt release, fire and sinking facts, staying inside the car, side impacts, deaths near home and the twenty five mile per hour crash comparison.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per myth fact; a contrast card for the two short trip numbers.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on belt myths and crash numbers.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach the handheld ban on public highways, stopped versus parked, adult hands free versus the full teen ban, emergency and on duty exceptions, and the teen penalties.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for stopped versus parked, adult versus teen, and emergency versus social calls.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on phone rules, exceptions and teen penalties.
